title: Refund of a Removed Business Add-On Card Fee — Northgate Memberships
content:
When the primary member of a Northgate Memberships business membership removes a business add-on cardholder, the add-on card fee charged for that card for the current membership year is refunded against that fee charge and returned to the charge's tender.

## What the refund write records

Member services books the refund of the add-on card fee of a removed business add-on cardholder. One call records a removal refund entry on the membership ledger against the stated add-on fee charge, for the stated card and membership year, returned to the stated tender; the cards themselves are not changed. The member sees the refund on the ledger and on the tender it is returned to.

## Invocation

The tool is `refund_removed_addon_card_fee_e7b2031f`, an agent-side tool: member services unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the membership reference number, as returned by the membership lookup | identifier |
| `membership_card_id` | the reference number of the add-on card issuance the fee was charged for, as returned by the membership card lookup or shown on the add-on fee entry | identifier |
| `source_txn_id` | the reference number of the add-on fee charge the refund is booked against, as returned by the membership ledger lookup | identifier |
| `term_end_date` | the last day of the membership year the add-on fee paid for | calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, local club date, never empty |
| `refund_amount` | the refund amount | USD with 2 decimal places, always positive; stored rounded half up to 2 decimal places as passed |
| `tender` | where the refund is returned | one of the tender codes below |

`tender` takes exactly one of:
  - `cash_or_debit` — back to the debit card or as cash when the charge was paid that way;
  - `northgate_visa` — back to the member's Northgate Rewards Visa card;
  - `northgate_store_card` — back to the member's Northgate Store Card;
  - `other_credit_card` — back to the other credit card the charge was paid with;
  - `shop_card` — onto a Northgate Shop Card;
  - `reward_certificate` — never used for a refund destination, only for charges paid with a certificate;
  - `not_applicable` — never used for a refund, only for entries that carry no payment.

## Return

A text receipt reading "Add-on card fee refunded", followed by the refund entry reference on the membership ledger, the add-on card reference, the charge it is booked against, the amount in USD with 2 decimals, the tender and the membership year end (YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt starting "Add-on card fee refunded" means the refund is on the ledger.

## Points of reference

- *Which charge carries the refund?* The add-on card fee charged for the removed card for the current membership year.
- *Does the refund deactivate the card?* No; the cards themselves are not changed by the refund.
